content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Green Bay

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most professionals in Green Bay's manufacturing and healthcare sectors qualify through a combination of formal education and hands-on PM experience. PMI provides a detailed eligibility checklist on their website; Granite PM Academy can review your background at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Our Green Bay cohorts meet on a schedule that accommodates full-time employment. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-focused content across multiple sessions, earning all required contact hours to satisfy PMI's formal education mandate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance on the online application process. PMI will review your credentials and notify you when you're cleared to schedule your exam with their authorized testing partner.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence before test day. Schedule your exam at an authorized Pearson Vue testing center in or near Green Bay. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult concepts right up until you sit for the computer-based PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, maintain your PMP through PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) across experience, education, and giving back. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and workshops so you can keep your credential active while staying current with project-management best practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
